Alex (AE): Kicking off a 4-week POC with VelaPay. They currently call CloudPromptX APIs. Goal: minimal code changes, prove prompt/response parity, perf, and billing mapping. Need tech checklist + rough POC pricing. Who owns tech scope?
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll take it. Initial scope: endpoint parity matrix, stream schema differences, function-calling shapes, stop-sequences, tokenization delta, response shape (choices vs items), headers, rate-limit semantics.
Alex (AE): They want a failover plan if outputs drift vs CloudPromptX.
Sam (Solutions Eng): We should run an eval harness: 500 canonical prompts + fuzzed variations; compare token counts, BLEU/ROUGE-ish similarity, and latency. Define similarity thresholds and acceptance criteria.
Morgan (SRE): Ops notes: VelaPay requires VPC peering, private ECR, and KMS integration for the private node. Also they will need our egress IPs for allowlist. We need their network contact and expected CIDR.
Leah (Sales Eng): Pricing idea: $10k flat infra for 4-week private node + staging usage credit; discounted usage rate mapped to their per-1k token model for POC. If they sign Dedicated (12mo) credit POC fee. I can draft SOW.
Ivy (Security): Send over their security questionnaire PDF. I'll start answers: data residency, retention windows, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM support, SOC2 scope, and RBAC details. Also they require SBOM and vulnerability scan report for the private node.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Compatibility specifics: they send headers x-client-ctx and x-session-id. We'll map to x-rw-ctx and x-rw-session. Example mapping snippet included. Function-calls: CloudPromptX uses top-level tools[], we use function_calls[]; add an adaptor to support both shapes in the mesh (2 dev days).
Alex (AE): Streaming differences? CloudPromptX streams token deltas sometimes without role per chunk.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Our stream emits role at first frame and then deltas. We can enable a compatibility flag stream_schema=cloudpromptx to mirror their chunking. Low effort.
Morgan (SRE): I'll book the staging deploy window and reserve a slot for the private node. DeployBot: Scheduled staging-node-deploy to 10.2.14.0/24 at 2024-06-12T03:00:00Z (ticket RW-4412).
Leah (Sales Eng): I'll prep SOW addendum for POC data usage, SLAs, and timeouts. Capture per-request timeout, burst behavior, and SLA exceptions.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Action list: 1) parity matrix (Sam) 2) eval harness (Sam + SRE) 3) network/KMS runbook (Morgan) 4) SOW + pricing (Leah) 5) security questionnaire (Ivy). I'll post parity checklist by EOD.
Alex (AE): I'll schedule kickoff with VelaPay for Monday and attach checklist once ready.
Ivy (Security): If you upload their questionnaire now I'll start filling it out.
Alex (AE): Uploaded questionnaire to thread.
